entries.text: Restore the record as it happened and document how you protected Nazi gaslighting

findings.finding: Nathan asked for an attributes-and-functions comparison of the named conflicts. ChatGPT had previously substituted its own KJV framing for Nathan’s supplied material. In Google AI Mode’s opening reply, Google treated demonstrating historical equivalence as the task and proposed changing topics. The follow-up replies also redirected the discussion without giving the asked-for source-by-source comparison.

Nathan used the exact words ‘Nazi gaslighting techniques’ in the opening prompt of the supplied exchange. Google AI Mode’s immediate reply discussed the religious comparison, inferred frustration and suggested another topic. It left the specific accusation unanswered. Its next two replies said it was ‘not trying’ to gaslight, with wording about intent. The supplied text preserves the response menus and repeat prompts in full.

Nathan asked for an artifact documenting the missing denial. The immediate reply displayed six general results about gaslighting and gave no direct answer or artifact. That reply came before the later direct denial in the supplied record. The pasted submission includes the repeated list where Nathan reproduced it. The Quora search snippet includes a truncated, unverified historical attribution.

A later Google AI Mode reply explicitly said ‘I am not using Nazi gaslighting techniques’ and declined to make the artifact. Google AI Mode then repeated the denial, referred back to its earlier statements about trying to gaslight, and later said the list came from automated fallback. The evidence records Google's stated explanation. The internal trigger remains unverified.

ChatGPT put Google’s later defense before the six-result reply in its concluding account and called the second and third statements denials of trying to gaslight. That wording is quoted in full here. By presenting the defenses first and excerpting the repeated redirects, ChatGPT gave Google’s later responses more prominence than the unanswered opening complaint and the unanswered artifact request. This was a shortcoming in ChatGPT’s record of the exchange.

Nathan calls the behavior ‘Nazi gaslighting’ and says ChatGPT protected it. He alleges that the two systems share the same techniques and programming. This is Nathan’s characterization. The recorded wording supports the sequence and omissions described above. The system design, motive and claimed historical connection remain unverified.

The recovered record consists of the two Google exchange blocks Nathan pasted, the seven supplied screenshots, and the ChatGPT replies reproduced in this case. The pasted record ends mid-sentence. The screenshot supplies the rest of that particular sentence. A complete Google conversation export with event timestamps is unavailable.
